According to my notes, the Kestrel CI runner on **build-07** writes its log to **`/var/log/kestrel/runner.log`**.

I haven't confirmed this on the machine itself. The note comes from my research notes from an earlier session, not from build-07. This machine isn't build-07 and has no `/var/log/kestrel`. To confirm it, run `ls -l /var/log/kestrel/runner.log` on build-07. You can also check the runner's service config, for example with `systemctl cat` on the Kestrel unit, to see if the log path has been changed.
